# App Store listing draft

Copy-ready English metadata is in `en-US.json`. This is a release draft based on the PC prototype, not a submitted listing. Confirm all described features in the final iOS build before publishing, especially local engine/offline operation and PGN sharing/imports.

No pricing, subscription, advertising, privacy, availability, or exact Elo claims have been invented. Developer name, support URL, privacy-policy URL, categories, age-rating answers and screenshots remain to be supplied for the final App Store submission.

The name and subtitle fit 30 characters, promotional text fits 170 characters, description fits 4,000 characters, and keywords fit 100 UTF-8 bytes. Checked against Apple's metadata documentation:

- https://developer.apple.com/app-store/product-page/
- https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/platform-version-information

Do not copy these preparation notes into the public description.

Stockfish 19 verified as the latest official release on 2026-09-15: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/tag/sf_19 . Recheck the latest-release wording before publishing.
